score_interpretation.echo_chamber_score: BubbleIndex. Increases with repeated similar-video behavior, active engagement with agreeing content, low opposing-viewpoint engagement, low diversity, and low reflection/resistance. Decreases with broader content diversity, opposing-viewpoint contact, algorithm awareness, and active perspective-seeking behavior.
score_interpretation.algorithmic_influence_score: Estimated strength of personalization signals. Increases with rabbit-hole behavior and active engagement. Decreases slightly with algorithm awareness and active resistance behavior.
score_interpretation.polarization_risk_score: Estimated one-sidedness risk. Increases with BubbleIndex, low content diversity, low opposing-viewpoint engagement, missed-news patterns, and perceived feed separation. Decreases with diversity, opposing-viewpoint contact, awareness, and resistance.
score_interpretation.content_diversity_score: Estimated breadth of information exposure. Increases with varied platforms/topics/news exposure, engagement with other viewpoints, reflection, and active feed control. Decreases slightly when repeated recommendation loops dominate.

pca_explanation: PCA reduces the scaled ML feature matrix to two dimensions, pca_x and pca_y, so clusters can be visualized in a 2D scatter plot. The PCA coordinates are for visualization, not for explaining all variation in the data.
feature_scaling_explanation: Before KMeans clustering, all ML features are standardized with StandardScaler so each feature has comparable influence regardless of its original scale. This prevents 0-100 score columns from dominating binary or ordinal quiz columns.
